incidentbot: PagerDuty triggered PD-9876 for inference-serving.canary.latency (>p99). Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-9876 :rotating_light:
lee: Acked. I'm on it — checking canary dashboard and recent synthetic runs.
anika: I see a 15s spike aligned with the scheduled synthetic sweep, looks like overlap of two probes. No spikes on prod user traffic graphs.
lee: ok silencing PD-9876 for 10m to stop noise while we validate.
```
/pd silence PD-9876 10m
```
incidentbot: PD-9876 auto-resolved (duration ~1m23s).
lee: Confirmed auto-resolve. No user-facing errors in logs, only synthetic probe latency. Marking no customer impact :white_check_mark:.
anika: Created INF-321 to reduce canary sensitivity and add jitter to probe schedule. Will propose threshold + window change. cc @ops
lee: Handing off to jordan for the rest of the shift — notes in the ticket. If it recurs and impacts user traffic, escalate to runtime-team and page infra-sre.
jordan: Thanks — I'll keep an eye on canaries and the INF-321 patch. Good catch, team :thumbsup:
_meta: thread represents incidentbot-triggered pagerduty page that auto-resolved; short on-call coordination and follow-up ticket created
